</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The next hop type, currently we support the following types: <code>VPN</code>: VPN gateway; <code>DIRECTCONNECT</code>: private line gateway; <code>PEERCONNECTION</code>: peer connection; <code>NAT</code>: NAT gateway; <code>NORMAL_CVM</code>: normal cloud server; <code>CCN</code>: cloud networking gateway; <code>NONEXTHOP</code>: no next hop.</dd></dl>

## Import



vpc netDetect can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Vpc/netDetect:NetDetect net_detect net_detect_id
```


To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
